summary.intent: Debug why manual memory injection wasn't injecting any memories into agent prompts.
summary.outcome: Root cause was partially misdiagnosed (initially blamed candidate status, but user had 4 active records). Final fix was simply enabling the debug flag in memory-loop.json to get visibility into selection reports.

repo: injectionRejectionReason (memoryloop.go:1548) rejects records with non-empty status that isn't 'active' — candidate records are silently filtered out
Manual mode path in lifecycle.go:358-365 does an early return nil that skips RecordInjectionActivity at lines 388-408, so manual injections are never tracked
When PreviewSelection returns 0 matches in manual mode, no hook response is written — the agent gets zero feedback that the system ran
Debug mode in memory-loop.json (store-level flag) controls whether a debug prompt is written when no memories match

code.finding: injectionRejectionReason rejects any record where Status != '' && Status != StatusActive, silently blocking candidate records from injection
Manual mode returns nil early, before RecordInjectionActivity is called, so manual injections are never tracked in activity log
When PreviewSelection returns 0 matches in manual mode, function returns nil silently — no hook response written unless debug:true is set

workflow: Enabling a debug flag in a JSON config file (.entire/memory-loop.json) is a quick way to get selection report visibility without code changes
Screenshots from the user provided ground truth that contradicted the initial diagnosis — always verify assumptions against user-visible state

friction: Initial diagnosis was incorrect: blamed candidate status for blocking injection, but user actually had 4 active records — wasted investigation time
Silent failure mode (no feedback on no-match) made the bug very hard to reproduce and diagnose without debug logging
The debug flag exists but wasn't documented or surfaced to the user, requiring code archaeology to discover
open_items: Manual mode skips RecordInjectionActivity — manual injections are never tracked, understating injection counts for those records
Manual mode gives no user-facing feedback when no memories match — should write a 'no memories matched' hook response
Consider whether manual mode should allow candidate records (it already gates on user confirmation, so status gating is double-gating)
Files cmd/entire/cli/summarize/claude_test.go and summarize_test.go were modified — unclear why these were touched given the debug flag fix
